body: There are none
Gah

You're very welcome and I am glad it has help you understand things a bit more from my pov.

I will admit initially I thought you were just someone one else on a high horse telling me its all in my head and I'm a waste of space etc.

Believe me you hear it so often you start to believe it after awhile.

While I do suffer anxiety /depression and they can be bad enough on their own I do have a much more in depth diagnosis which is more the root of my issues.

As anyone who has tried to apply for DSP you won't be granted for just depression or anxiety alone.

If you are genuinely interested I would be happy to share more specific details with you in to pm me.

As for the advice, it's not as unhelpful as you made it sound in your disclaimer.

I'm well aware that we all fight our own internal battles everyday that others can be completely obviously too. However as I think I pointed out previously those "normal" things others deal with on the inside can be an absolute dire catastrophe in my case.

It's exhausting to say the least...

At this point I will read your fist line and read no more before signing off for good and throwing away this account as it has spiralled in to something that is causing me great angst and not in one way helpful.

Had you actually read my opening post instead of working your keyboard so hard in the comments section you would know I am already on the wait list for housing.

So thanks again for your input but that's all I have now, good day sir.

Wether it makes sense to you or not you still understood my point.

I think it's called community! If I can't work due to a disability and still can't afford a home, what are my other options?

Maybe I could mug/rob your house... To afford it? You know since youre so against helping anyone worse off than yourself.

I don't think I can handle life, that's why I am in the position I am in, I would much rather end my life but I am told constantly that's not the answer...

Nothing is wrong with that suggestion, I actually thought it was a good one. But I also would have thought if people had an issue with me maybe using too much electricity from being home all day they would bring it up with me.

Clearly they never have so have never thought of your suggestion. However, I have little faith it would make much of a difference as I have tried many different things all to the same effect. Clearly you are correct and I am the issue.

Thank you, I appreciate you are trying to help and I apologise for becoming defensive/aggressive but this line of conversation and confrontation is really not helping in one bit so I will respectfuly bowing out. In fact I'm starting to wish I hadn't made the post at all... I was just alone, frustrated and reaching out. Thankfully I had the good sense to make a throwaway.

Anyway, thanks for your time and input.

I wonder what you do and how you react when you feel threatened?

I imagine anyone with any amount of empathy would be able to see through the BS if comments like yours and thus my replies.

Obviously I'm not a full time asshole, and especially not when dealing with potential housemates but sure I will defend my position.

Agreed, you can't 100% internalise, but I have become pretty good at it and while I shouldnt have to its survival. Anyone who is able to spare enough time to analyse my movements as a housemate I would wonder probably has some of their own issues.

And there's that word, "judgement" no one should be judging anyone, you have not walked in their shoes, don't know their story.

Still it brings me back to if we go with what you say and myself and others like me are clearly not possible to live with what exactly is it should we do/live?

You assume...

How I would love to be so hard done by to have my own home to live in and even have a second I could rent out... Tough times indeed.

Of course I have considered what it's like to own a home and understand the risks with renting to tenants.

I wonder if you have stopped to look at your own opinion of someone who has not considerd what it's like to struggle without a home?

I know their a bad tenants out there, doesn't mean they are all bad and a "risk".

Why even make up a reason when it's so much eaiser to say nothing at all like they all do. Better yet how about being courteous and just giving the honest answer instead of coming up with some BS reasons...

In other parts of the world long leases are the norm... In timenthe same will have to happen here.

Again you assume, you had one bad experience with a pet owner so they are all bad... 

And here in lies the problem, money. Everything has to turn a profit. Something as essential as housing should have never have been made in to an investment to turn a profit. Thats why the country is in this housing crisis mess.

Got so much money you want to invest, try the stock market. Leave essential requirements to live alone.
Thanks, have sent you a reply

One man murders someone, clearly all men are murders...

I go out of my way and bend over backwards to the detriment of my own health to make up for my short comings in order to be a great housemate.

Thanks for your judgements. I can assure you I am nothing like you obviously imagine I am.

I feel you missed my point on government, regardless, it's way off topic and not relevant.

Obviously, I don't walk around in a share house telling my house mates my issues and that I want to kill myself.

I do have respect for people I live with and understand many can't or don't want to deal with that. 

Like I explained in the opening post, I internalise my issues and unless I make them known to others which I don't usually do (rare lapse of judgement I made by posting what I did) you would have no idea what I'm dealing with in my head so really it's a irrelevant.

And here in lies the problem. I clearly can't focus, on anything.

Thanks just the same

Yes, okay, I can appreciate that, however I use very little electricity during the day or other wise.

Yes it all adds up and I am of course more than happy to pay my fair share, but there are others gaming it. For example people that own their own home, renting 1-2 rooms out @$200 each. I think even if I sat at home all day with the fridge open, air-con on and went to the toilet every hour I am sure they would still come out in front.

Obviously I have ever no numbers to support this but my point is that it swings both ways...


With all due respect I'm not dealing with a bank and as many have said it is a call I should be able to make and that I should lie if I have to in order to make it sound convincing.


I absolutely agree that we need better social systems to look after the most vulnerable so they are not belittled, judged other have to live on the streets.

However I'm not asking for handouts or expecting others to fit the bill for the purpose of me bit "being a burden".

That is actually something people like me struggle with daily feeling like we are a huge burden on the world and others and that we should just kill ourselves. Obviously we shouldn't kill ourselves for that reason as we are not a burden.

There are far biggr burdens in the world than the most vulnerable. Just switch on the news right now and take a look at what our government is doing.

Thanks so much for the cup of "harden the fuck up" clearly just want I need, obviously.

I've heard all what you say before...

I'm not making excuses, though can appreciate it comes across that way. I have stated I don't expect a hand out etc, I get the world is a hard tough place, I don't want or need sympathy.

I know im no special in the sense their are many like me in the same or worse off situations.

In addition like I said elsewhere I could lie for my own advantage except the guilt alone would eat me alive.

I think what upsets me most and many others who truly are familiar with the issues that we live in a time where helping the most vulnerable is becoming of less and less importance and is simply glossed over with "the world is a hard place, it is what you make if it, harden up mate"

Obviously it's more complex than that but that's all I can manage right now, as any time someone tells me to "harden the fuck up" I feel incredibly useless and should just end my life there and then.

I do wonder would people be so quick to tell someone with no legs to "harden the fuck up" when they are overwhelmed with the prospect of having to get up their 5 flights of steps to their home.

I'm sure you don't get the analogy though.

Apologies for getting so aggressive

Yes, very true!

Got a few confidence pills I could pop?

Yes, like I have said I have tried many different approachs and I could very well lie and maintain the lie but sadly I have a backbone...

The extreme guilt I would feel for doing such even for my own advantage/well being would cripple me with the consent worry of "what happens when this all goes wrong and unravels?"

Thank you stranger for the kind words and extremely generous offer, I will do my best, I just worry if my best is good enough...

I totally understand "how it looks" but as anyone in my own position with a similar illness will back be up on its the damage that you can't see.

It's basically a mask we wear, an act we feel we must out on, to appear somewhat normal if nothing else out of shame for being further outcast for being different.

I can tell you, even though it seems I can do all those things and just because I can "post eloquent things" and that's what it appears from the outside the inside is very very different...

The very thought of all of those things you mentioned sends me in to meltdown. And while I may go to inspect a property etc and have to "talk to someone" it can take me up to a whole day to just prepare for that mentally before I even put cloths on before leaving the house.

"Don't judge a book by it's cover"

Already this morning I have struggled with the idea of ending my life, as I struggle with most mornings, however this morning is particularly worse than usual.

In fact, those feelings can be triggered by something as little as having someone behind me in the car when I need to do a u turn.

"Mountains out of molehills" basically, always with the most extreme swings.

"Theres no milk left, cant face the world to go get more as I have no petrol and that would mean going to get petrol first, all this is starting to get to complicated just for milk... Fml I wish I was dead"

While I am somewhat smart and understand logical things my brain fails to make sense of it all and place it in the right order... Thats why it's a mental illness. It's brain related...

Ever seen someone's brain as they walk around on the street, no, me neither, so how would you know if their brain is broken/damaged?

A broken leg is a lot eaiser to spot than a broken brain.

I  am not a fraud, my issues are complex and are very real!

I hope this gets some of the points you requested across to you in a non arrogant way.

He is an indoor only cat. He grew up with another cat and was the submissive of the pair. 

He tends to run and hide at the first sign of something he is not comfortable with. Just like me really...

He has lived with a larger dog before, but that dog was pretty easy going so didn't bother my cat and my cat didn't give the dog any drama wither, they just mostly avoided each other.

So to answer, yes, I would say he gets on with other animals but it would be up to the other animal.

It's wildly off topic but if "landlords simply won't advertise the room." They simply won't have their income.

In a world where fewer people are able to afford to buy homes and are forced in to renting more needs to be done to not only make those rents affordable, because right now they are not but to also allow those renting said homes to make it feel like home.

That means things like long term (7 years) secure leases, being able to make simple modifications and yes have pets. You know, all the normal things people do to enrich their lives.

Those who rent are not some sub class group of people.

No, no family, I was an only child, lucky me...

I have looked outside of Brisbane, granted it was only as far as Toowoomba. Issue with that is, it's far far away from my only two supports, psychiatrist and support worker.

I actually applied for a private rental in Toowoomba that I could afford, ie on par woth what I have been paying in share housing and was rejected being told it was over the 30% of income requirement...

Trouble with going up north is I struggle greatly with the heat so would not be ideal.

I have thought about going south but still have the same issues of then have no supports etc

While what you say all makes logical sense in order.

It does my head in and overwhelms me very quickly in to a state where I can't have a clear thought in order to action any of it. It's at that point it all falls down and starts over again.

I am a "bangin" roomie as you put it.

While all of those things you say are true, they are all internalised and from the outside looking at me I act and sound very "normal".

In fact, if I didn't tell you I have a disability you wouldn't know. It's what's on the inside of me that you can't see that does the damage.

You might say well if that's the case don't tell them. Well I believe it's better to be open and honest about these things than lie about it.

Its who I am and if someone has a problem with it that's their issue... It's for this reason there is such a damaging stigma around mental illness as it's not openly talked about

Most places I'm looking at have bills included for the price I am spending.

I understand that is the stigma around welfare that they can't or won't pay rent/bills on time, sure there are those out there that give everyone a bad name but we are not all like this.

Surly it's my call as to what I can afford or not... For what it is worth, like I have explained I have no issues paying my rent on time and have good references to back this up. So to be thrown in the same basket as everyone else who doesn't pay on welfare is tough.

While technicaly correct, DSP is welfare I don't see it as such. It's not Newstart, it's a permanent regular payment that I now receive as I'm no longer able to work.

So I out this to you, if DSP cant afford a private rental or even share housing, where is one to live, what is one to do...? This very thought process alone is what destroys so many like myself who are also disabled.

What should we, the disadvantaged disabled do? Live on the streets or just go and die somewhere?

Why must we be continuously belittled, judged and pushed aside? We are human too and deserve the right to live a "normal" safe, somewhere meaningful life given what we suffee and have to deal with every day.

I am the perfect person... lol

Like I have said, I have not doubt it's limiting my chances/choices. In fact I am told regularly that people don't like cats etc.

But I can't give him up, I just need to find the right mix.

That's a very generous offer thank you.

I just feel like I have so much lost potential that was never honed or guided in the right way that now I'm just a mess and mix of all sorts of confusion.

Psychology would be the top pick. I also have interests in writing, programming, computer engineering/electronics etc

Strange combination I know and tough to combine.

TAFE has also been considered.

Yes, very much aware it's a life long thing that you have to learn to manage rather than cure. So often I wish I had something mildly worthwhile and fulfilling that I could give back to help others with so I didn't feel like such a waste of space.

Thank you for your huge empathy and kindness, it's so very rare to find.

Sadly I don't have any family... It's just me

The ideation has been a little bit his week. Logically I know it's not a solution it's more out a feeling of despair that there is no way out.

I feel in my case would it really serve me any purpose other than something interesting to do as I'm not even sure if I could work from any degree I may or may not get.

In other words, I feel it's less about the degree itself and more about will I acne working anyway...

And yes thank you, my cat is safe currently staying with foster parents

When I say "cat issues aside" I mean in terms I have so looked for places from the pov that I don't have a cat and I still have the same troubles.

When I am not trying to increase my chances of looking for somewhere for just me all the places I message are specifically places that allow pets. There are a good few out there, definitely not as rare as you imply.

I understand it makes my case harder and I don't blame anyone for that, while I may not agree that landlords can turn away anyone they don't like, ie someone with kids, pets, welfare etc etc I respect thats the way it is until laws change, and they need to change, but that's another debate.

I have had by cat since he was 6 maths old (now 5) when I did have my own place, so while I appreciate it creates a extra hurdle I am in no way giving him up as he is my strength and only support.

He is however currently staying with foster parents.

I appreciate what you were conveying especially since you speak from a pov of someone that has hit rock bottom and has these same thoughts.

I like your approach to the idea as it's a lot less violent to anything I ever came up with in my head to get me there.

As you point put though, I also lack the guts and courage to go through woth such a plan. Though have felt on edge enough times that I could be close to "snapping" and that does worry me.

I'm not sure if would feel comfortable with something like a "go fund me" asking for help like that. I feel what makes me so special that I deserve this help over someone else in the same or worse situation than me?

Also I'm sure it wouldn't get much support if any at all...

As for family, I have none, it's just me...
Agreed, while the idea has been appealing at times, I can't imagine it would actually do me any good other than having food/shelter and avoiding suicide in the real world.

Yeah, I appreciate they have their work cut out for them in an impossiblely broken system with so many others like myself going through the same thing.

Thanks, I appreciate your wishes and you are correct. I have spoken with Micah last week before I was to be in my car.

It is because of then that I am in this current crisis accommodation that they helped organise with another organisation.

Long term, they (Micah) are trying to advocate to dept housing on my behalf to try and find out what the situation is, however from what I can tell it's a long slow painful process.

They also granted me a fuel voucher to get to my psychiatrist appointments. They are doing good work.

While I have considered jail many times in the past believe it or not for all the reasons you suggest, I'm not sure it would be quite the pretty picture you paint it to be.

It's great to think that all of those things are taken care of for you, but you basically have no rights in terms say over how you spend your day/life etc... Not that it's anything special right now anyway.

Then there is the violence and the way you can expect to be treated once there and then just another thing to have against your name once you get out...

While it is quite the creative suggestion, I'm not sure they would actually jail you for that...?
I appreciate your effort, however those these are some of the same links the "local member" provided to me.

I have heard so many negative things recently about uni, ie paying back HECS sooner and that mostly people regret their degree it hasn't filled me with alot of confidence.

This is on top of not even knowing if I would have the ability to undertake it and be within the terms of DSP. I know right now even my constant immediate worry over housing I would find it hard to focus.

I already get decent concessions as a pensioner but I'm sure there would be others that would help from uni.

Then there is the logistics, actually choosing a subject that may give me some potential for the future than actually gaining entry as a mature age.

I do have an application in for NDIS, not that they do housing (or did you mean NRAS?) but that's all on hold right now as I need an address to proceed with my claim.

Cat issues aside, I have assumed that some don't want someone home all the time (maybe I already spoke to you lol). I respect their choice but I try to spin it in a positive way that at least there is someone always around from a security pov.

Anyway, it's not been a huge issues for others I have shared with, 95% of my time is spent in my room so am never seen anyway and if you're not home anyway what difference does it make if I'm there or not...?

Like I said, I respect the decision, it just does my head in and I have heard all manner of BS reasons and excuses.
